title: Inlining a known small file set is far cheaper than letting a worker explore
summary: In EXP-0007 the same extraction with the files inlined (spotlighting) cost 17k input tokens and ~8 s per call, versus 36k-74k tokens and 36-46 s when the Codex worker located and read the files itself; accuracy was identical (16/16). When a task's inputs are known and small, attach them instead of paying for tool exploration -- this also makes the task self-contained, which the key-optional API workers (role inline) require.
